<!-- Do not include private household data, credentials, addresses, device IDs, or family media. -->

## Problem

What user problem should be solved? Separate measured facts from assumptions.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior and where it fits in the adapter/layer architecture.

## Privacy and safety

Does this add a network target, upload, deletion, credential, model download, public listener,
automatic action, or stronger safety claim? Explain the opt-in and fail-closed behavior.

## Alternatives and verification

What alternatives were considered, and how can the change be tested with generated fixtures?

## Third-party boundary

List any upstream URL, exact revision, license, model weight, dataset, or media asset involved.
